name: What are the first steps a remodeler should take to implement AEO?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps a remodeler should take to implement AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first steps for a remodeler implementing AEO involve understanding your target audience's questions. Start by conducting thorough keyword research to identify common queries related to your services (e.g., "how much does a kitchen remodel cost?" or "best bathroom renovation materials"). Next, audit your existing website content to see where these questions are already addressed or where new content is needed. Begin creating or optimizing content, particularly FAQ pages and blog posts, using clear, concise language and structured data where appropriate. Finally, monitor your search performance to track featured snippets and direct answer visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodelers should start AEO by researching common customer questions, auditing existing content, creating/optimizing new content with clear answers, and monitoring performance.
